newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Three stowaways missing from Malaysian ship.
newsitem.headline: Three stowaways missing from Malaysian ship.

text.p: Three stowaways on board a Malaysian container ship were missing after fears they had jumped overboard off the Queensland coast, a Australian maritime rescue official said on Monday.
The two Australian women and a man were thought to have jumped from the Bunga Tearsek on Sunday, off Princess Charlotte Bay, after lifejackets went missing following their detection.
The Bunga Tearsek was enroute from Singapore to Brisbane.
"An air search of the area by five aircraft late yesterday failed to find any trace of the people," an Australian Maritime Safety Authority official told Reuters.

"There is some doubt now they jumped into the water and may still be on board. Customs and immigration officials will conduct a thorough search of the ship when it arrives in Brisbane on Wednesday," the official said.
The two women, aged 20 and 21, and a male, aged 28, and were believed to have been on board the ship since early February.
"They were believed to be returning for the second time on the same ship after being hidden by crew members," the official said.
